props.note: A basalt boulder stand-in marking a coral-encrusted mound outcrop at the Desmophyllum pertusum thicket POI. The engine has no coral-colony model, so this generic rock (Poly Haven, CC0) stands in for the reef structure; it is not a depiction of coral itself. Scale 6 gives a ~6 m outcrop, a modest estimate for a colonised mound feature.
Second boulder stand-in, part of the same thicket cluster as coral-mound-boulder-1. Same caveats: a generic rock model in place of an unmodelled coral colony, purely illustrative.
